subject.title: [Bug] Dreaming narrative: hardcoded 60s timeout includes lane-queue wait; timeout disposal aborts the primary call then discards the successful fallback-model output

question: What public memory-core Dream Diary timeout and cleanup contract should maintainers accept for this issue?
rationale: The source bug is credible, but exposing or reshaping dreaming.execution.* affects public plugin config and overlaps the existing timeout-only PR plus broader Dream Diary controls work.

options.title: Broader Narrative Contract
options.body: Define one public Dream Diary control shape covering timeout, queue/execution deadline semantics, and cleanup/late-output behavior, then update manifest, runtime, docs, and tests together.

options.title: Timeout-Only First
options.body: Refresh and prove the open timeout-config PR, then track queue-time attribution and late-output cleanup separately.

options.title: No New Config Surface
options.body: Fix queue-time accounting and timeout cleanup internally while leaving operator-facing Dream Diary controls unchanged.

recommendation.title: Broader Narrative Contract
recommendation.body: Define one public Dream Diary control shape covering timeout, queue/execution deadline semantics, and cleanup/late-output behavior, then update manifest, runtime, docs, and tests together.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent memory-core SDK seam and release history touches the config/runtime surfaces, making this the best available owner for the contract decision.
